title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
  
  
Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
  
  
**About The Team**
We build and operate Expedia Group's core CI infrastructure that powers engineering teams across multiple domains. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable, and scalable build systems—spanning native, backend, platform, and service teams—enabling developers to ship high‑quality software with confidence.
  
  
A high performing and influential individual contributor who leads by example while continuing to mentor junior engineers, interfaces consistently with tech leadership in the local organization, leads complex and vaguely-defined projects, and stretches into team leadership skills based on current projects.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Design, implement, and operate native cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and platform services that enable rapid, reliable delivery of applications across multiple domains.
* Build, configure, and maintain automated deployment, monitoring, and observability solutions to ensure high availability, scalability, and performance of critical services.
* Drive improvements in infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, and environment standardization to increase reliability, reduce manual work, and improve developer productivity.
* Partner with engineering and architecture teams to define system design, including low-level design, API integration patterns, and data flows that align with operational and security best practices.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve outcomes, including familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products.
* Lead incident response, problem management, and post-incident reviews, using data and metrics to drive continuous operational excellence across services and platforms.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Relevant technical degree or equivalent practical experience in software engineering, computer science, or a related field with a focus on infrastructure, systems, or DevOps.
* 9+ years of Extensive hands-on experience in native cloud environments operating production systems, including ownership of one or more services or platforms end to end.
* Demonstrated expertise in CI/CD tooling, infrastructure-as-code, and automation, including build, test, deployment, and environment provisioning workflows.
* Strong proficiency in system design, including low-level design of infrastructure components, API integration, networking, security controls, and data modeling for operational systems.
* Proven experience monitoring, scaling, and troubleshooting distributed systems in production using logs, metrics, and alerts to maintain reliability and performance.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with implementing and tuning remote build caching (Gradle Enterprise, Bazel Remote Cache).
* Experience with tuning macOS build performance, concurrency, resource allocation, filesystem tuning, or virtualization.
* Strong AWS experience — compute, storage, networking, autoscaling.
* Experience with Terraform, packer, GitHub suite(GH Actions, workflows and runners)
* Experience driving large-scale CI improvements across multiple teams or orgs, having the ability to lead ambiguous technical initiatives with minimal direction.
* Deep experience designing and operating complex, large-scale cloud-native platforms or multi-service environments with strong emphasis on resilience, capacity planning, and cost optimization.
* Track record of leading architecture and design for deployment pipelines, infrastructure platforms, and operational tooling, including defining standards and best practices across teams.
* Advanced expertise in observability, incident management, and reliability engineering, using data-driven approaches to improve SLIs/SLOs and reduce operational toil.
* Experience integrating and operating AI/ML‑enabled or AI-assisted systems in production (such as intelligent monitoring, automated remediation, or optimization pipelines), including safely leveraging AI tooling to enhance DevOps workflows.
* Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products in the context of deployment automation, infrastructure optimization, or reliability engineering.

**Accommodation requests**
Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation.
  
  
**About Expedia Group**
Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.
  
  
**Important notice**
Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: Group Bayport - Senior DevOps Engineer - Docker/Kubernetes
description:
**Role / Designation:**
Senior DevOps Engineer
  
  
**Location:**
Gurgaon
  
  
**About Group Bayport**
Group Bayport, headquartered in Atlanta (USA), is a rapidly growing global e-Commerce B2B2C, B2B and B2C organization that has re-defined the business of delivering high-quality custom products through a unique blend of cutting-edge digital technologies, robust manufacturing capabilities and global supply chain. An industry leader in print technology, Group Bayport operates in the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, UK, and India through its family of brands - BannerBuzz, Covers & All, Vivyx Printing, Circle One, Giant Media, Neon Earth, Optamark and Northcape.
  
  
While our advanced technology and customer focus are certainly our salient attributes, our true strength comes from our team of 2000+ people. Having scaled to USD 150mn in 14 years, we believe we are at the cusp of exponential and disruptive growth ahead. For more about Group Bayport, please visit www.groupbayport.com
  
  
**Role Summary**
As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining highly available systems and ensuring smooth, reliable application deployments. You will work closely with development and operations teams to implement best-in-class DevOps practices, including proactive monitoring, automated alerting, and self-healing mechanisms. You will also help implement cutting-edge tools to automate infrastructure and streamline processes.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Architect Scalable & Reliable Systems:
* Design and implement highly available, scalable, and secure AWS cloud infrastructure using services such as EKS, EC2, S3, and RDS.
* Manage multiple environments (prod/uat/stg/dev) and applications housed in different EKS & ECS clusters.
* Strong experience in performing technical RCAs and ability to design systems and take technical trade off decisions.
* Infrastructure Automation & Optimization:
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or Ansible.
* Automate provisioning, scaling, and monitoring of cloud infrastructure (EKS, EC2, S3, RDS, etc.).
* CI/CD Pipeline Development:
* Develop and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodePipeline and Github Actions for applications built with PHP, Java, Node.js, Next.js, and React.js.
* Ensure continuous integration and deployment workflows with automated testing and validation.
* Proactive Monitoring & Self-Healing Systems (SRE):
* Architect and implement proactive monitoring using ELK Stack, New Relic, and AWS CloudWatch for real-time system visibility.
* Develop self-healing systems to automatically resolve server failures, application crashes, or service downtimes.
* Cloud Management:
* Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure in a multi account setup.
* Strong hands on core AWS services including EC2, EKS, ECS, S3, CloudWatch, RDS, Opensearch, Lambda and SNS.
* Security & Compliance:
* Ensure DevSecOps implementation in the CI/CD.
* Manage security of the complete infrastructure including Cloud, Application & Web firewalls against DDOS etc. attacks.
* Ensure systems are complaint to PCI, SOC-1 etc. compliances.
* Database & Search Services:
* Work with databases such as Elasticsearch and MariaDB.
* Manage indexing and search services like Algolia to ensure efficient query performance and data integrity.
* Cross-Team Leadership:
* Collaborate with development, operations, and security teams to integrate DevOps processes across the organization.
* Lead DevOps best practices for infrastructure management, deployment, monitoring, and security.
* Performance Engineering:
* Designs systems that are performance first by using technologies and approaches like caching, rapid scaling etc.
* Use Fastly CDN to optimize content delivery and improve website performance.
* Cost Optimization:
* Design cost-effective cloud architectures while maintaining high performance.
* Implement efficient resource-scaling strategies based on traffic patterns.
* Continuous Improvement:
* Promote DevOps culture by driving automation, code quality, and collaboration.
* Stay updated on emerging DevOps trends and technologies, suggesting improvements to existing systems.
* Ability of utilising AI ChatBots and Agents to automate tasks, monitor and build self healing systems (AIOps).
* Collaboration:
* Work closely with developers to ensure seamless integration between development and operations.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventive measures.

**Job Qualification & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 4+ years of relevant experience in DevOps & CloudOps, with a strong focus on high-transaction, microservices-based systems.

**Technical Skills**

* Experience setting up and maintaining DevOps infrastructure for applications handling hundreds of transactions per second.
* Strong expertise with AWS services (EKS, EC2, RDS, S3, SNS, CloudWatch, etc.).
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as AWS CodePipeline.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Hands-on experience with monitoring and logging tools (CloudWatch, New Relic, ELK Stack).
* Expertise in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Ansible, or AWS CloudFormation.
* Proficiency with Fastly CDN or similar content delivery networks.
* Strong understanding of Linux system administration.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases (MariaDB, Elasticsearch, MongoDB).
* Knowledge of APM tools such as New Relic for performance monitoring.
* Familiarity with scripting languages (Bash, Python, etc.).

**Behavioral Skills**

* Strategic & System Design thinking
* Planning and organizing
* Interpersonal skills
* Stakeholder management
* People leadership
* Innovation and creativity
* Attention to detail

title: DevSecOps Engineer, IE&O
description:
**Position Title:**
DevSecOps Engineer, IE&O
  
  
**Position Type:**
Regular - Full-Time
  
  
**Requisition ID:**
45078
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The DevSecOps Engineer is a senior hands-on engineering role within the Enterprise Infrastructure Platform Engineering team. The role designs, implements, secures, and operates resilient cloud infrastructure and enterprise DevSecOps platforms, with a strong focus on automation, developer enablement, governance, reliability, and measurable delivery outcomes.
  
  
Working primarily with Microsoft Azure and also Google Cloud, the engineer partners with platform architects, security, application, data, and AI teams to embed security, quality, observability, and change controls throughout the software delivery lifecycle. The role also advances responsible use of generative and agentic AI in infrastructure-as-code and engineering workflows, supported by appropriate guardrails, human oversight, and FinOps discipline.
  
  
Success in this role means: secure-by-design platforms, reliable automated delivery, faster developer flow, auditable change, and reduced operational toil.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Platform Engineering & Reliability:**
Design, implement, and monitor secure, fault-tolerant, highly available cloud infrastructure and DevSecOps platform services.
  
  
**CI/CD & Release Engineering:**
Establish and continuously improve build, test, release, and deployment frameworks that support scalable delivery, traceability, auditability, and repeatability.
  
  
**DevSecOps Adoption:**
Drive adoption of DevSecOps and cloud platform capabilities across application, data, and AI engineering teams through reusable patterns, enablement, and technical guidance.
  
  
**Security by Design:**
Embed SAST, DAST, IAST, software composition analysis, secrets management, policy enforcement, and security quality gates into CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
**Infrastructure as Code:**
Build and maintain modular, tested, and governed infrastructure automation using Terraform, Ansible, and related tooling.
  
  
**GitOps & Kubernetes:**
Implement GitOps-based delivery and lifecycle management for container platforms using technologies such as Kubernetes, AKS, GKE, Argo CD, Flux CD, Helm, Docker, and Podman.
  
  
**Toolchain Availability:**
Engineer and operate reliable services supporting source control, artifact management, containerization, continuous integration, release management, change management, and developer workflows.
  
  
**Automated Governance:**
Integrate automated change-management controls, approvals, evidence capture, policy-as-code, and promotion controls across development-to-production pipelines.
  
  
**Observability & Self-Healing:**
Integrate metrics, logs, traces, event analytics, and automated remediation to improve service health, troubleshooting, performance, and resilience.
  
  
**Performance & Operations:**
Lead technical analysis, optimization, incident response, problem resolution, upgrade planning, operational readiness, and lifecycle management for DevOps infrastructure.
  
  
**Cross-Functional Architecture:**
Translate development, security, operations, reliability, and compliance requirements into implementable platform designs and engineering standards.
  
  
**AI-Assisted Engineering:**
Apply generative and agentic AI to accelerate infrastructure engineering and automation while maintaining human oversight, security guardrails, governance, and cost accountability.
  
  
**Documentation & Enablement:**
Produce clear technical documentation, reference architectures, standards, runbooks, and reusable implementation guidance; coach teams on engineering best practices.
  
  
**Automation Culture:**
Identify repetitive manual processes and replace them with secure, supportable, observable automation.
  
  
**Required Skills And Experience**
Core Experience
  
  
**10+ years of relevant experience**
in DevSecOps, platform engineering, cloud engineering, task automation, or GitOps.
  
  
**Hands-on engineering experience**
designing and operating enterprise-scale CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, container platforms, and automation frameworks.
  
  
**Strong programming and scripting capability**
using Python, Bash, PowerShell, Groovy, Java, C#, C++, or comparable languages.
  
  
**Proven operational discipline**
across incident response, problem management, performance analysis, upgrade execution, high availability, and technical documentation.
  
  
**Strong communication and collaboration skills**
with the ability to work effectively across architecture, security, infrastructure, application, data, and AI teams.
  
  
**Technical Capabilities Required**
**Capability Area**
**Expected Experience**
**Cloud Platforms**
Microsoft Azure (Must); Google Cloud Platform (Nice to have).
  
  
**Source Control & CI/CD**
GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent enterprise platforms.
  
  
**Infrastructure as Code & Configuration**
Terraform, Terratest, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, Salt, or equivalent tools.
  
  
**Containers & Orchestration**
Kubernetes, AKS, GKE, kubectl, Helm, Docker, Podman, or comparable technologies.
  
  
**GitOps & Continuous Delivery**
Argo CD, Flux CD, or equivalent GitOps tooling.
  
  
**Application & Supply-Chain Security**
SonarQube, Snyk, Akido, Chaingaurd, SAST, DAST, IAST, software composition analysis, dependency scanning, secrets scanning, and quality gates.
  
  
**Artifact & Package Management**
JFrog Artifactory or equivalent artifact repositories.
  
  
**Observability**
Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, or equivalent monitoring, logging, and analytics platforms.
  
  
**ITSM & Work Management**
ServiceNow, Jira, automated change integration, and auditable delivery workflows. Handson Experience of integrating DevOps tools chain and ServiceNow and Jira Integration
  
  
**Testing & Service Virtualization**
Selenium, Tosca, automated functional/performance/security testing, and service virtualization tools.
  
  
**Linux & Networking**
Ubuntu, Debian, Alpine, RHEL; TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, SSL/TLS, SMTP, FTP, and cloud networking fundamentals.
  
  
**AI-Enabled Engineering**
GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or comparable AI coding and engineering assistants, used within defined governance and security controls.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Bachelor’s degree**
in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
  
  
**Relevant public cloud certification**
in Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud is required.
  
  
**DevOps, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, or CNCF certification**
is preferred.
  
  
**Experience with Agile and DevOps delivery methods**
and with planning, estimation, and delivery in a fast-paced enterprise environment.
  
  
**Demonstrated learning agility**
with the ability to evaluate and adopt emerging technologies responsibly.
  
  
**Preferred Attributes**

* Systems thinker who balances developer experience, security, reliability, governance, and cost.
* Self-starter who can operate with appropriate autonomy while maintaining strong stakeholder alignment.
* Pragmatic engineer who favors standards, reusable products, automation, and measurable outcomes over one-off solutions.
* Curious and adaptable, with a commitment to continuous learning and responsible adoption of AI-enabled engineering practices.

Key Outcomes
  
  

* Secure delivery: Security and compliance controls are consistently embedded and evidenced within delivery pipelines.
* Reliable platforms: DevSecOps services meet defined availability, performance, recovery, and support expectations.
* Faster flow: Standardized automation reduces manual effort and enables repeatable, lower-risk releases.
* Developer enablement: Product teams can adopt approved cloud and DevSecOps capabilities through clear, reusable patterns.
* Operational excellence: Observability, incident learning, self-healing, and continuous improvement reduce recurring issues and operational toil.
* Responsible AI adoption: AI-assisted engineering improves productivity without compromising security, governance, quality, or cost control.

title: Platform Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Title:**
Platform Engineering Manager

**Location:**
Gurgaon

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Department:**
Analytics

**About Axslogic**

Axslogic is a fintech analytics enterprise software company that helps financial institutions digitize their lending data analytics while they progress their overall digitization journey. The company's flagship product, Winnow™, creates a new early warning exception management paradigm to manage challenges and risks associated with lending businesses. Founded by domain experts, Axslogic provides cutting-edge business analytics solutions that enable better portfolio performance and improved profitability for financial institutions. The company is headquartered in Singapore, with offices in India and the UAE.

**Role Overview**

Axslogic is seeking an experienced and skilled
**Platform Engineering Manager**
to join our team and drive the automation, scalability, and security of our cloud-based infrastructure. The ideal candidate will lead efforts to build and maintain a robust cloud platform that supports our patented SaaS / Managed SaaS products providing Early Warning and Predictive Analytic capabilities to financial institutions. This role requires strong expertise in
**DevOps practices**
, deep
**hands-on experience with AWS**
, and a thorough understanding of
**IT security as it applies to DevOps and cloud infrastructure**
.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps**

* Design, implement, and manage CI/CD pipelines to support agile development practices
* Administer, monitor, and optimize AWS infrastructure (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, CloudFormation, EKS, etc.)
* Ensure platform deployment in secure Tier III or above Data Centers that offer very high level of uptime (99.982%) with multiple telecom peers, 100% redundant capacity and compliance to ISO 27001:2013 standards
* Implement and manage disaster recovery strategies and facilities
* Automate infrastructure using IaC tools like Terraform or AWS CloudFormation
* Monitor systems performance, ensure high availability, and troubleshoot issues

**Security & Compliance**

* Define and enforce security best practices across development and deployment environments
* Implement data encryption mechanisms using asymmetric-symmetric key systems specific to each client
* Manage secure SFTP/FTPS servers and ETL processes that handle sensitive financial data
* Set up and maintain LDAP/Active Directory based authentication systems
* Conduct risk assessments and recommend enhancements to improve overall DevOps security posture
* Support compliance with ISO 27001:2013 standards

**Team Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead and mentor a team of cloud engineers and DevOps specialists
* Collaborate with developers, QA, and security teams to ensure safe and secure deployments
* Work with product teams to understand application requirements and design infrastructure solutions
* Partner with data science teams to create infrastructure that supports analytics capabilities
* Stay current with AWS updates and security trends to proactively enhance systems

**Required Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in DevOps or Cloud Engineering roles
* Strong expertise in
  **AWS cloud infrastructure management**
* Hands-on experience with
  **CI/CD tools**
  such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, CircleCI, or similar
* Proficiency in
  **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**
  tools: Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi
* Solid understanding of
  **IT security principles**
  , especially in DevOps environments (e.g., IAM, secrets management, network security, vulnerability management)
* Experience with
  **containerization and orchestration**
  (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/EKS)
* Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or similar
* Familiarity with log aggregation, monitoring, and alerting tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Prometheus, ELK, Datadog)
* Experience with handling sensitive financial data and knowledge of related compliance requirements
* Experience with job control platforms like Airflow
* Proven track record of leading technical teams and managing complex infrastructure projects

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Solutions Architect)
* Experience with compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA)
* Background in scripting development in Bash and Python
* Experience with GitOps practices
* Knowledge of IBM and Oracle platforms that support analytics solutions
* Understanding of financial services domain, particularly lending analytics
* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architectures
* Engineering Graduate from a top-tier college

**Why Join Us?**

* Work on Winnow™, a cutting-edge patented SaaS platform that provides pre-programmed early warning capabilities and state-of-the-art reporting and analysis for financial institutions
* Support a robust solution with over 1500 Alert Thresholds, 250+ Reports with multi-variate segmentation over 60+ dimensions
* Build infrastructure for a platform that disrupts traditional manual processes in financial risk management
* Use cutting-edge cloud infrastructure tools and participate in advanced security implementations
* Help shape a secure and scalable DevOps culture within a fast-growing fintech company
* Work with a strong management team with significant domain expertise in Commercial Lending, Banking, and Consumer Financial Services
* Competitive salary and benefits
* Flexible working arrangements and a collaborative team environment
* Join a global team with offices in Singapore, India, and the UAE

**About Our Technology Stack**

Our Winnow SaaS platform is implemented using world-class platforms and requires expertise in maintaining a secure, high-performance cloud infrastructure. The platform handles sensitive financial data and powers analytics that help banks and financial institutions make critical business decisions. As Platform Engineering Manager, you'll be responsible for ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of this crucial infrastructure.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer I
description:
**Do you enjoy building reliable cloud platforms using Azure, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation?**
**Would you like to help create secure, scalable systems while collaborating with software engineering and security teams?**
**About The Business**
LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Business Services vertical, we offer a multitude of solutions focused on helping businesses of all sizes drive higher revenue growth, maximize operational efficiencies, and improve customer experience. Our solutions help our customers solve difficult problems in the areas of Anti-Money Laundering/Counter Terrorist Financing, Identity Authentication & Verification, Fraud and Credit Risk mitigation and Customer Data Management. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at https://risk.lexisnexis.com/
  
  
**About The Team**
We deliver powerful digital solutions that help customers tackle some of the world’s most significant challenges. Our Software Engineering team develops innovative, customer-focused products that create meaningful value and impact.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer I, you will contribute to the design, automation, and reliability of our cloud infrastructure, with a strong focus on Azure and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). You will collaborate across teams to improve deployments, observability, system availability, security, and operational processes across our environments.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and manage scalable infrastructure on Microsoft Azure.
* Manage and maintain AKS clusters, including provisioning, scaling, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and deployments using Terraform, Helm, and Argo.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions integrated with Azure services.
* Containerize applications using Docker and deploy them to AKS.
* Collaborate with Information Security teams to ensure secure and compliant infrastructure.
* Optimize networking configurations and troubleshoot connectivity issues across cloud environments.

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
****Overview:****
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 34,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers human connection.
  
  
Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4.6B in 2023.
  
  
Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
  
  
Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection
*.*
**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
  
  
Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
***Recruitment Scam Notice:***
*Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “*
*name@cvent.com*
*” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.*
*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.*
*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.*
*https://www.cvent.com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud*
*.*
****In This Role, You Will:****
Cvent is seeking a Senior Engineer to join our Cloud Infrastructure team in Gurugram, India to help build and maintain the platform behind our event and hospitality SaaS business. This is a high impact engineering role for a person who thrives at:
  
  

* solving complex platform challenges,
* partnering with our internal technology teams to support Cvent’s customers, and
* executing complex technical infrastructure changes with minimal to no disruption

In this role you will help keep infrastructure hosted on on-premises operational while looking at strategies to migrate said infrastructure into Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud environments along with Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) cloud environments as needed. You will drive the evolution of secure, scalable infrastructure that supports both customer-facing applications and internal platforms our engineering teams depend on to build and operate software at scale.
  
  
****In This Role, You Will:****

* Build and improve internal infrastructure platforms with a focus to migrate to cloud environments.
* Develop automation driven by self-service workflows that accelerate delivery of infrastructure while strengthening governance and reliability.
* Bring observability maturity to hybrid environments using Datadog, CloudWatch, or equivalent across both cloud and on-premises workloads during the migration window.
* Participate in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation alongside an experienced global team and contribute to incident response with clear root-cause analysis.
* Partner closely with Security, Database, Enterprise Services, and SRE teams across India, UK, US, and Canada to solve complex cross-functional infrastructure challenges.
* Provide senior technical direction through design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and hands-on problem solving.
* Identify and implement practical uses of generative AI to improve internal tooling, automation, and speed of execution.

****How You Will Spend Your Time****
This role drives technical change partnering with technical leaders across a worldwide team. A typical allocation is:
  
  

* 50% hands on engineering and automation development.
* 25% code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance.
* 25% operational support and partnership with internal customers.

****Here's What You Need:****
**Must-Have**

* 8+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, and/or Security Engineering.
* Strong experience building automation, CI/CD pipelines (via Github Actions, Jenkins, and/or ArgoCD), configuration management, and infrastructure tooling using Python, TypeScript, or similar languages.
* Proven experience designing and operating AWS infrastructure in high-scale, multi-account, multi-region production environments.
* Experience with configuration management and systems automation using tools such as AWS Systems Manager, Chef, Ansible, Ansible AWX, Foreman, Red Hat Satellite.
* Experience supporting Linux (Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Rocky, Amazon, CentOS) environments in enterprise-scale infrastructure
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with other engineers, stakeholders, and technical leadership.

**Nice-to-Have**

* Hands-on experience with serverless architectures and AWS services such as Lambda, Step Functions, IAM, and related platform components.
* Strong experience building observability solutions in Datadog, migrating from other platforms such as Checkmk, Prometheus, Grafana, Solarwinds, Splunk, Nagios, and/or Zabbix.
* Experience building or improving internal developer platforms, self-service tooling, or cloud governance frameworks.
* Experience building infrastructure-as-code solutions using AWS CDK, ideally with TypeScript.
* Experience designing and operating infrastructure on-premise infrastructure, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience in networking including BGP, Direct Connect, or AWS Transit Gateway for enterprise-grade hybrid connectivity.
* Experience using Active Directory and Group Policy to manage access and system configuration.
* Experience with Bash, Microsoft PowerShell, VMware PowerCLI and transforming these scripts into automation tooling built on Python via AWS Step Functions and AWS Lambda.
* Experience with on-premise hypervisor platforms such as VMware ESXi, KVM, Proxmox, and/or Nutanix.
* Experience with Real Time Communications (RTC) and video streaming technologies including Real-Time Messaging Protocol (RTMP), HTTP Live Streaming (HLS), WebRTC, Pexip Infinity, Vonage Video (formerly Tokbox OpenTok), Adobe Media Server, Wowza Streaming Engine, and/or FreeSWITCH.
* Experience with NVIDIA Compute Unified Device Architecture (CUDA).
* Experience evaluating emerging technologies and translating them into practical platform improvements.
* Understanding of Kubernetes infrastructure especially Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) and/or Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
* Understanding of web servers such as NGINX and Apache HTTP and web application services such as Oracle WebLogic and Apache Tomcat.

**Success Factors**

* You identify high-leverage opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale cloud operations
* You bring strong technical judgment and ownership to ambiguous, high-impact infrastructure challenges
* You create clarity through standards, documentation, and architectural direction that others can build on
* You multiply the effectiveness of the team through mentorship, collaboration, and principled engineering leadership

**On-Call and Work Model**
Because Cloud Infrastructure supports a 24x7x365 environment, this role participates in an on-call rotation. Our global team structure is designed to make this sustainable: the rotation is typically one week approximately every six weeks, with daytime coverage shared across regions and handoff to our Rest of World (ROW) team overnight.
  
  
**This Role Follows Our Current Hybrid Schedule:**

* Work from home on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday
* Work in the office on Wednesday and Thursday

description:

**How You Will Contribute**

* Build the evaluation framework used to determine whether an AI application is fit to go live, covering component, trajectory and end-to-end outcome measurement, with defined pass thresholds integrated into the delivery pipeline.
* Work directly with business subject-matter experts to define correct outcomes and convert them into maintained benchmark datasets.
* Design and calibrate automated judging, validating it against human review so that reported scores are meaningful and defensible.
* Own repeatable adversarial testing for prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool misuse, guardrail bypass and data leakage, and rerun the suite after every material model or prompt change.
* Implement runtime safety controls, including content filtering, sensitive-data redaction, tool permissions, spend caps and circuit breakers.
* Instrument applications so quality, latency, tokens and model cost are observable per request, application and tenant.
* Own model-cost optimisation through routing, caching and prompt efficiency, using evaluation evidence to demonstrate when a lower-cost model is sufficient.
* Monitor production quality and drift, maintain a failure taxonomy, and feed observed failures back into benchmark datasets.
* Validate model upgrades before cutover so vendor model changes do not degrade client-facing systems.

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in software, data or AI/ML engineering, with strong Python capability and hands-on experience building production-grade agentic or LLM applications for real users using LangGraph or equivalent frameworks, tool calling and retrieval.
* Demonstrable experience designing AI evaluations and measuring retrieval quality, including defining measures and scoring methods, assessing groundedness and relevance, diagnosing failures, distinguishing genuine regressions from noise, and running online evaluations over sampled production traces.
* Practical experience implementing model-safety controls and adversarial testing, including prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool misuse, data leakage, filtering, redaction, guardrails, spend limits and loop controls.
* Experience accessing and deploying models across multiple providers, understanding cost, latency and capability trade-offs, and working with self-hosted or open-weight models, fine-tuning, distillation or prompt optimisation.
* Consulting or client-facing delivery experience, including the ability to work with non-technical subject-matter experts to define correct outcomes and translate their judgement into maintained benchmark datasets.
* Hands-on OpenTelemetry instrumentation for nested, multi-step agents, including tool-call spans, session and conversation tracing, trace-context propagation across asynchronous workers and queues, and correlation IDs through background processing.
* Experience with LLM observability tools such as Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix or Weights & Biases Weave; integration with platforms such as Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Grafana or Datadog; and structured telemetry for token usage, latency and cost by request, application and tenant.

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer – OpenStack / Ceph / KVM
description:
**XLoud | Delhi , India | 4–8 years**

**About XLoud**

XLoud builds sovereign private cloud infrastructure on open technologies: OpenStack, KVM, Ceph and Kubernetes. We design, deploy and run production clouds for enterprises and government customers, and help them move off VMware onto open, KVM-based platforms using our own migration tooling (XMS). The engineers here own real infrastructure, from bare metal to tenant workloads.

**What you will do**

* Deploy, operate and scale production OpenStack clouds (Kolla-Ansible), including Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Glance, Keystone, Octavia and Magnum.
* Handle day-2 cloud administration: availability zones, host aggregates, flavors, quotas, project/tenant management, and performance tuning.
* Troubleshoot OpenStack services and the infrastructure underneath them: compute, networking, storage and control plane.
* Run Ceph clusters in production: OSD add/remove/recreate, flag management, PG and recovery tuning, capacity planning, and RBD/CephFS/RGW operations.
* Manage KVM/QEMU and libvirt, including CPU pinning, NUMA, huge pages, and GPU/SR-IOV passthrough for high-performance workloads.
* Execute VMware-to-KVM migrations for customers using XMS, from discovery and planning through cutover.
* Operate Kubernetes clusters on OpenStack (Magnum / Cluster API) for containerised and microservices workloads.
* Build automation with Bash, Python, Ansible and Terraform for provisioning, configuration and repeatable operations.
* Configure and debug networking: TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, VLAN, VXLAN, OVS/OVN, bridging, routing, iptables, DNS and DHCP.
* Manage physical servers through iDRAC, iLO and IPMI/BMC: provisioning, firmware and hardware fault handling.
* Monitor platform health with Prometheus, Grafana and ELK/OpenSearch, and act on alerts before customers notice them.
* Apply security hardening and access controls aligned with ISO 27001 and customer compliance requirements.
* Meet SLAs and follow ITSM processes for incidents, changes and problem management.

**What you bring**

* 4–8 years in private cloud infrastructure, with hands-on OpenStack administration in production.
* Strong Linux administration on RHEL/Rocky and Ubuntu: installation, kernel tuning, LVM, filesystems, performance analysis and upgrades.
* Hands-on Ceph operations experience.
* Solid networking fundamentals and comfort debugging at the packet level.
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes and automation tooling (Ansible, Terraform).
* Ability to work directly with customer teams and explain technical trade-offs clearly.

**Good to have**

* RHCSA / RHCE, Red Hat OpenStack, or CKA certifications.
* Experience with SDN/NFV, OVN, or DPDK.
* VMware vSphere background, especially migrations off it.
* GPU infrastructure (vGPU, MIG, passthrough) for AI workloads.

**Why XLoud**

You’ll work on the full stack, from hardware to the cloud control plane, with a small team that builds and runs its own platform. The problems are real, the impact is direct, and you’ll learn more in a year than most roles teach in three.

*All academic credentials must be from recognised institutions and are subject to verification.*

description:

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**About GoKwik**
GoKwik is India’s leading D2C Commerce Growth Platform, helping 15,000+ brands acquire, convert, engage, and retain shoppers. Powered by a network of 200M+ shoppers, 500M+ checkouts, and 1.5B+ customer conversations, we’re building the operating system for commerce growth.
  
  
Why This Role Matters
  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer III to build and scale the core backend platform that powers merchant onboarding, storefronts, inventory management, and integrations with eCommerce platforms such as Shopify and WooCommerce.
  
  
The role involves designing reliable, scalable backend services, making architectural decisions, and improving the performance and operational efficiency of production systems. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to build reusable platform capabilities, reduce manual interventions, and support the growing needs of merchants. You will also contribute to technical direction, engineering standards, and the development of other engineers on the team.
  
  
What You’ll Own
  
  

* Backend Platform Development: Design, develop, and maintain core backend services and reusable platform capabilities for merchant onboarding, storefronts, inventory management, and external integrations.
* System Design and Architecture: Own low-level and high-level designs for shared services. Make decisions around APIs, data models, failure handling, performance, scalability, and maintainability, and document design decisions clearly.
* Distributed Systems and Kafka: Design and operate event-driven systems using Kafka, including topic and partition strategies, consumer groups, message ordering, idempotency, retries, dead-letter queues, consumer lag monitoring, and schema evolution.
* System Performance and Optimisation: Improve SQL query performance, caching, queuing, and service efficiency. Investigate production bottlenecks and implement solutions that address root causes.
* Platform Integrations and Data Synchronisation: Build reliable, bi-directional integrations with eCommerce platforms and external systems. Use patterns such as outbox, change data capture (CDC), reconciliation jobs, and backfills while accounting for third-party API rate limits.
* Scalability and Multi-Tenant Architecture: Design systems that support multiple merchants reliably, including data partitioning and sharding, workload isolation, backpressure management, and appropriate consistency models.
* Production Reliability and Observability: Own production reliability through on-call support, incident response, root-cause analysis, postmortems, and service-level objectives (SLOs). Use observability and application performance monitoring tools, including SigNoz, to identify and resolve issues.
* Infrastructure and Cost Optimisation: Identify opportunities to reduce infrastructure costs, manual support work, and recurring merchant-specific fixes without compromising system reliability or delivery speed.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Product, Frontend, Infrastructure, and Engineering teams to plan delivery, communicate technical decisions and risks, review designs, and manage production priorities.
* Technical Leadership: Lead design reviews, establish engineering standards, review critical changes, and mentor SDE I and SDE II engineers. Contribute to technical direction across teams and promote clear documentation and execution practices.
* AI Systems and Engineering Tools: Apply AI-assisted development tools where appropriate and demonstrate an understanding of AI system design, including LLM inference, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, agents, and guardrails.

Who You Are
  
  

* Have 6+ years of software engineering experience in a product or platform company, with hands-on ownership of production backend systems.
* Have strong low-level and high-level system design skills and can evaluate trade-offs, justify architectural decisions, and take accountability for outcomes.
* Have extensive hands-on experience with Kafka in production, including partitioning, ordering guarantees, consumer groups, rebalancing, delivery semantics, idempotency, dead-letter queues, lag monitoring, and failure recovery.
* Have experience designing and scaling high-throughput systems, with measurable examples of improvements in throughput, latency, data volume, or system capacity.
* Possess strong distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency and availability trade-offs, sharding, rate limiting, backpressure, and graceful degradation.
* Have a solid understanding of SQL databases, data modelling, transactions, indexing, query optimisation, caching, and queuing systems.
* Have practical experience with production ownership, on-call responsibilities, incident management, reliability targets, root-cause analysis, and permanent corrective actions.
* Have experience with application performance monitoring and observability tools, preferably including open-source solutions such as SigNoz.
* Have demonstrated the ability to optimise database queries and infrastructure costs.
* Can communicate technical designs, document services, manage technical stakeholders, and explain complex engineering decisions clearly.
* Are proficient in Node.js or Golang and their associated frameworks, or have strong experience in one of these languages with the ability to contribute to the team’s technology stack.
* Demonstrate strong ownership, data-driven decision-making, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving problems.
* Have experience mentoring engineers and contributing to technical standards and engineering practices.

Why GoKwik
  
  
At GoKwik, you will work on core commerce technology that supports a growing ecosystem of D2C brands. You will have the opportunity to solve complex backend and distributed systems challenges, shape platform architecture, improve production reliability, and influence engineering practices across teams. The role combines hands-on development with technical leadership and offers the opportunity to build scalable, reliable systems that support the next phase of commerce growth.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role for an engineer who combines deep expertise in distributed systems and backend architecture with strong product thinking and organizational influence.
  
  
As a Principal Engineer, you will work on some of Payoneer's most complex technical challenges, define architectural direction, drive engineering excellence, and enable multiple teams to build reliable, scalable, and resilient systems.
  
  
The role also requires an AI-first mindset in identifying opportunities to use AI and agentic technologies to improve how we build, operate, and evolve our products and engineering systems. You will also help explore and build systems using emerging protocols and technologies such as MCP (Model Context Protocol).
  
  
****What You'll Do****

* Define and drive the technical and architectural vision for large-scale backend systems and distributed platforms.
* Design and build highly scalable, resilient, secure, and fault-tolerant distributed systems supporting Payoneer's global financial infrastructure.
* Solve complex technical problems spanning multiple systems, services, teams, and domains.
* Drive architectural decisions and establish engineering patterns, standards, and best practices across teams.
* Lead the evolution of backend platforms toward greater scalability, reliability, observability, performance, and developer productivity.
* Act as a technical leader and trusted advisor to engineering leadership, product leaders, and other stakeholders.
* Work closely with engineering teams to identify and address systemic technical challenges and technical debt.
* Champion an AI-first approach to software engineering, identifying opportunities to leverage LLMs, AI agents, automation, and intelligent developer tooling across the software development lifecycle.
* Explore, prototype, and drive adoption of emerging AI technologies, including MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agent-based architectures, where they can create meaningful business or engineering value.
* Partner with teams across engineering, product, security, infrastructure, data, and other functions to solve complex cross-domain problems.
* Influence technical strategy across multiple engineering teams and organizational boundaries, without relying solely on direct authority.
* Mentor and coach engineering leads, senior engineers, and architects, helping raise the technical bar across the organization.
* Help develop the next generation of technical leaders through architecture reviews, design discussions, technical mentorship, and knowledge sharing.
* Establish and promote practices around engineering excellence, system design, reliability, security, testing, observability, and operational readiness.
* Lead technical initiatives that require coordination across geographically distributed and cross-functional teams.
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and continuously evaluate how they can improve Payoneer's engineering capabilities.

****What We're Looking For****

* Extensive experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems and backend platforms.
* Strong expertise in backend engineering, system architecture, APIs, microservices, data-intensive systems, and cloud-native architectures.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts including consistency, availability, fault tolerance, concurrency, distributed transactions, messaging, event-driven architectures, and scalability.
* Proven experience leading architecture and technical strategy across multiple engineering teams or complex technology domains.
* Strong track record of taking ambiguous, complex problems and translating them into scalable technical solutions.
* Experience operating systems at significant scale with strong requirements around availability, performance, security, and reliability.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, observability, production operations, and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience with AI/LLM technologies and a demonstrated interest in building AI-first engineering systems and workflows.
* Familiarity with AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), tool calling, agentic workflows, or similar emerging AI technologies is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence engineering and product decisions across organizational boundaries.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor senior engineers, tech leads, and technical leaders.
* Strong product mindset and the ability to balance technical excellence with business outcomes.
* Comfortable working in a globally distributed, cross-functional engineering environment.

****What Success Looks Like****
In this role, success means having an impact beyond the systems you directly build.
  
  
**You Will:**

* Shape the architecture and technical direction of critical Payoneer platforms.
* Enable multiple engineering teams to build and operate better distributed systems.
* Raise the technical bar through mentorship, architecture leadership, and engineering practices.
* Help Payoneer adopt an AI-first engineering culture and identify high-value opportunities for AI and agentic technologies.
* Drive successful adoption of emerging technologies such as MCP where appropriate.
* Improve the scalability, reliability, security, and efficiency of our platforms.
* Become a trusted technical partner to engineering, product, and business leadership.

**Why This Role**
The Principal Engineer role provides an opportunity to operate at the intersection of technology, architecture, product, and organizational leadership.
  
  
You will work on complex problems at global scale, influence technology strategy across teams, mentor the next generation of engineering leaders, and help shape how Payoneer builds software in an increasingly AI-first world.
  
  
**The Payoneer Ways of Working**

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Industry Solutions
description:
**Job Description**
MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the #1 most wanted database, preferred by developers. MongoDB continues to attract the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software.
  
  
To support this growth, we are expanding our Industry Solutions Team (IST), a flexible, globally distributed organization that helps customers and partners modernize applications and data platforms with MongoDB.
  
  
As a Forward Deployed Engineer in our Industry ISV Practice, you will work directly with independent software vendors (ISVs) and their engineering organizations to build MongoDB capabilities into their products. You will work in the partner’s codebase, languages, engineering practices, and release process to deliver production-ready integrations, migrations, and product capabilities. The solutions you help build should leave the partner with maintainable code and knowledge, while creating reusable patterns that can accelerate future partner engagements.
  
  
This is a hands-on application engineering role. You will spend time understanding existing products built on relational databases, designing practical MongoDB approaches, writing production code, and working alongside partner engineers through implementation and rollout. The role requires regular travel and time on-site with ISV partners during key phases of the engagement.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
What you’ll do at MongoDB
  
  
In this role, you will
  
  

* Embed with ISV engineering teams, adapting to their codebase, practices, release cadence, and constraints while understanding their product architecture, industry context, data model, and deployment environment
* Design and build MongoDB-backed product capabilities, including integrations, data models, indexes, queries, persistence layers, migration tooling, and support for MongoDB alongside relational database editions
* Design and implement coexistence and migration solutions, including synchronization, change data capture (CDC), dual writes, consistency, application refactoring, validation, and controlled cutover
* Design and validate production-ready solutions for performance, scalability, resilience, observability, security, and operational readiness across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes-based private clouds, and self-managed or restricted on-premises environments
* Enable partner engineers through collaborative development, code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing, while working with internal technical teams to resolve design questions and establish support boundaries
* Capture reusable implementation patterns, tooling, product gaps, and lessons learned to accelerate future partner engagements

As an ideal candidate, you will have
  
  

* 5+ years of hands-on backend engineering experience building and operating production applications
* Strong application-side expertise with MongoDB, including data modeling, access patterns, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, and a clear understanding of query and transaction semantics
* Application-level fluency with at least one major relational database, including relational data modeling, access patterns, database drivers or ORMs, indexing, transactions, query planning, and transaction-isolation assumptions
* Experience integrating a new database into a large production codebase and migrating production workloads, including persistence abstractions, data synchronization, dual-write or CDC patterns, application refactoring, validation, and incremental rollout
* Strong coding ability in at least two languages such as Java, C#/.NET, Node.js/TypeScript, Python, or Go, plus experience with APIs, distributed systems, containers, and cloud or self-managed deployment environments
* Experience with SaaS and product engineering, including multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, and backward compatibility, together with the ability to work effectively in unfamiliar codebases and explain technical trade-offs clearly
* Willingness to spend significant time on-site with ISV partners and travel within the region

As an ideal candidate, you may also have
  
  

* Experience working for or with an ISV, or in a forward-deployed, embedded, resident-engineer, or partner-engineering role
* Familiarity with event-driven and microservices architectures and technologies such as Kafka, as well as performance engineering, observability, resilience, or production-readiness reviews
* Exposure to security and compliance requirements for ISVs serving regulated industries
* Experience creating reusable tooling, reference implementations, integration components, or technical documentation, along with MongoDB certification, Atlas experience, or familiarity with MongoDB’s broader product portfolio

What you will learn
  
  

* Gain practical experience modernizing applications and delivering MongoDB solutions for partner products across different industries, including coexistence and migration scenarios in cloud-native environments, while developing reusable patterns and your technical and communication skills
* Broaden your perspective on how data-intensive products evolve and develop the judgment to translate diverse product and operational requirements into practical MongoDB solutions

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**About Atlys**

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers. Atlys is changing that.

We're building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.

**The Role**

We're looking for a DevSecOps Engineer to own the foundations that keep Atlys fast, reliable and secure.

Not someone who simply keeps servers running or closes tickets from a scanner. We're looking for someone who treats infrastructure and security as products: who designs systems that are secure by default, automates away toil, and gives every engineer a paved road to ship safely.

Few companies handle data as sensitive as ours. Passports, financial documents, photographs and identity records flow every day between travellers, partners and government systems across 127 countries. You'll own the cloud infrastructure, security posture and reliability of the platform that processes it, and make sure it scales as we grow.

We're looking for someone who doesn't just ask how to pass the next audit, but how to build systems that are fundamentally hard to break.

**The Job**

* **Own our cloud infrastructure.**
  Build and run scalable AWS/GCP infrastructure with Kubernetes and make deployments repeatable and fast.
* **Data security.**
  Design access controls, audit logging across internal tooling and cloud infrastructure for PIIs like passports and financial documents, in line with compliance and data security
* **Secure the supply chain.**
  Add SAST, DAST and dependency and container scanning to CI/CD, run vulnerability management and pen tests
* **Vulnerability Discovery:**
  Find, validate and fix security gaps - business logic flaws, authorization issues, authentication bypasses, injection vulnerabilities

**The Ideal Candidate**

You'll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Have 4–6 years of experience in infrastructure, DevOps, SRE or security engineering roles, ideally at a fast-growing product company handling sensitive or regulated data.
* Have deep hands-on experience with any public cloud, Linux, networking, Docker and Kubernetes
* Have a strong grounding in security fundamentals including but not limited to OWASP Top 10 and cloud security best practices and have applied them in production, not just on paper.
* You can own security gaps in application layer and can validate and fix them yourself across the tech stack
* Take ownership end to end. You make pragmatic trade-offs between security, speed and developer experience. You explain risk clearly and bring engineers along rather than acting as a gatekeeper.
* Prior web/backend development experience is nice to have.

We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.

**What you can expect**

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here's what you can expect:

title: Senior Technical Account Manager
description:

This role exercises independent judgment and creative solutioning to ensure customer success. The STAM may coordinate the activities of other team members (team lead) to ensure successful completion of projects and assignments. This role is responsible for mentoring and providing guidance and advice to new team members. The STAM proactively develops and maintains strategic relationships with key customer stakeholders, serving as a trusted advisor and technical leader. This position contributes to overall business growth by driving customer satisfaction and retention.
  
  

* Lead complex technical troubleshooting and problem resolution efforts for critical customer issues.
* Develop and deliver technical tutorials and workshops to customers and internal teams.

* Collaborate with sales and product management teams to develop and support the implementation of customer solutions.
* Serve as a technical mentor and coach for junior team members.
* Contribute to the development of new support tools and processes.
* Lead internal initiatives to improve team performance and customer satisfaction.
* Identify and drive initiatives to improve service delivery processes.
* May be required to work on customer site and connect to customer systems.

**What You'll Do**

* Perform technical reviews & share knowledge to proactively identify & prevent issues
* Understand your customers' technical infrastructures, hardware, processes, and offerings
* Perform initial or secondary investigations and respond to online and phone support requests
* Deliver key portfolio updates and assist customers with upgrades
* Manage customer cases and maintain clear and concise case documentation
* Create customer engagement plans & keep documentation on customer environments updated
* Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction with each qualified engagement through the complete adoption life cycle of our offerings
* Engage with Red Hat's field teams, customers to ensure a positive platform & cloud technology experience and a successful outcome resulting in long-term enterprise success
* Communicate how specific Red Hat platform & cloud solutions and our cloud road-map align to customer use cases
* Capture Red Hat product capabilities and identify gaps as related to customer use cases through a closed-loop process for each step of the engagement life cycle
* Engage with Red Hat's product engineering teams to help develop solution patterns based on customer engagements and personal experience that guide platform adoption
* Establish and maintain parity with Red Hat’s platform & cloud technologies strategy
* Contribute internally to the Red Hat team, share knowledge and best practices with team members, contribute to internal projects and initiatives, and serve as a subject matter expert (SME) and mentor for specific technical or process areas or process areas
* Travel to visit customers, partners, conferences, and other events as needed

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in science or a technical field; engineering or computer science
* Competent reading and writing skills in English
* Ability to convey information to customers in a clear and concise manner
* Ability to effectively manage and grow existing enterprise customer and partner relationships by delivering best-in-class support
* Advanced troubleshooting and debugging skills, with a passion for problem solving and investigation
* Upstream involvement in open source projects (patches submitted for upstream) is a plus
* Indian citizenship or authorisation to work in India
* Red Hat OpenStack Platform - RHOSP

+ Fundamental understanding of OpenStack, Container architecture, and administration experience across all working components
+ Deep understanding and troubleshooting skills on OpenStack core components.
+ Deployment and troubleshooting experience of OpenStack clusters on bare metal or non-bare metal environments.
+ Planning, Designing, and implementation of OpenStack products on various hardware.
+ Technical and Deep understanding of Ceph cluster storage and its functionalities.
+ Experience with Linux operating system installation, configuration, upgrade, and maintenance.

+ Strong working knowledge of Prometheus and Grafana open source monitoring solutions will be considered a plus
+ Administration experience of Red Hat OpenShift v4.x will be considered a plus
+ Competent comprehension of enterprise architecture and strategic business drivers

* Direct experience with a variety of hardware vendors

**About Red Hat**
Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
  
  
**Inclusion at Red Hat**
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
