People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.
  
  
As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
  
  
**About The Role**
Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.
  
  
We’re looking for an Infrastructure Engineer (Compute) to design and build core systems that manage containerised and virtualised workloads running on bare-metal and hybrid environments. This role is ideal for engineers who love working close to the kernel, building tools that abstract hardware complexity, and optimising infrastructure for scale and speed.
  
  
Up for the challenge? Let’s get in touch.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Designing and maintaining compute layer, focusing Kubernetes on bare metal
* Developing infrastructure-agnostic tooling and APIs to manage hybrid cloud environments at scale
* Ensuring infrastructure reliability through proactive detection/remediation of hardware failures and auto-healing
* Managing hardware lifecycle, from procurement and installation to decommissioning and upgrades
* Collaborating closely with network, security, and DevOps teams to ensure seamless integration between physical infrastructure and public cloud
* Documenting infrastructure processes, configurations, and best practices

**What You'll Need**

* 5+ years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages
* 3+ years of experience managing physical hardware
* Experience with Kubernetes on bare metal and open-source storage solutions (Ceph, MinIO)
* Experience automating infrastructure tasks using Infrastructure-as-Code tools
* Deep knowledge of data center operations, including power distribution, cooling, and rack management
* Familiarity with server hardware and storage systems (Dell, HP, Supermicro)
* Solid troubleshooting and problem-solving skills related to hardware failures and performance bottlenecks
* Expertise in one or more object-oriented programming languages (Go, Java, Python)
* An academic background in STEM

**Nice to have**

* Professional certifications (e.g., CCNP, CKA, Google Cloud, Red Hat)

That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

title: Infrastructure Engineer II
description:
**Job Description**
The Infrastructure Patching & Security Engineering team ensures the security, stability, compliance, and operational resilience of enterprise infrastructure platforms through proactive patch management, vulnerability remediation, security hardening, automation, and continuous improvement.
  
  
The team is responsible for maintaining secure and compliant Red Hat Linux, Windows environments by implementing enterprise patching strategies, addressing security vulnerabilities, reducing infrastructure risk, and ensuring adherence to organizational security standards.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Windows Server, VMware, system administration, OS patching, vulnerability management, infrastructure security, automation, and scripting. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing enterprise-wide patching operations, remediating security vulnerabilities, troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, and driving automation to improve patch compliance and operational efficiency.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**OS Patching & Infrastructure Security Operations**

* Plan, coordinate, execute, and manage enterprise-wide operating system patching across Red Hat Linux and Windows infrastructure.
* Own end-to-end patch management activities, including patch assessment, planning, testing, deployment, validation, reporting, and remediation.
* Manage monthly, emergency, and out-of-band security patching cycles across production and non-production environments.
* Implement security patches, critical updates, kernel upgrades, and operating system fixes in accordance with enterprise security policies.
* Identify and remediate missing patches, outdated software packages, and infrastructure security vulnerabilities.
* Troubleshoot patch installation failures, dependency conflicts, repository issues, reboot failures, and post-patching system issues.
* Ensure patching activities are executed within approved maintenance windows with minimal business disruption.
* Develop patch rollback, recovery, and contingency procedures to minimize operational risks.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, cybersecurity, and change management teams to ensure timely patch deployment and compliance.

**Red Hat Linux, Windows & VMware Administration**

* Build, configure, administer, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise Red Hat Enterprise Linux and Windows Server environments.
* Perform Linux patching using YUM, DNF, RPM, Red Hat Satellite, and related patch management tools.
* Manage Windows Server patching using Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), WSUS, or equivalent enterprise patching platforms.
* Support VMware ESXi and vCenter patching, upgrades, lifecycle management, and security remediation.
* Troubleshoot Linux kernel issues, package dependencies, system services, boot failures, filesystem issues, and OS performance degradation.
* Administer Windows Server infrastructure, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and Windows Update services.
* Perform server health checks, pre-patching readiness assessments, and post-patching validation.
* Support operating system upgrades, end-of-life remediation, server migrations, and infrastructure modernization.

**Vulnerability Management & Security Remediation**

* Partner with cybersecurity and vulnerability management teams to identify, assess, prioritize, and remediate infrastructure vulnerabilities.
* Analyze vulnerability scan results from tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or equivalent enterprise security platforms.
* Remediate critical and high-severity vulnerabilities within defined security SLAs.
* Investigate vulnerabilities associated with operating systems, software packages, system configurations, and infrastructure components.
* Implement security hardening recommendations based on CIS benchmarks, vendor guidance, and enterprise security standards.
* Address security findings related to outdated packages, insecure protocols, weak configurations, unsupported operating systems, and missing security patches.
* Support vulnerability exception management, risk acceptance processes, and remediation tracking.
* Coordinate with application owners and infrastructure teams to resolve vulnerabilities requiring application compatibility testing or planned downtime.
* Maintain accurate vulnerability remediation records, compliance evidence, and audit documentation.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce vulnerability exposure and infrastructure security risk.

**Patching Automation & Scripting**

* Design, develop, and maintain automation solutions for enterprise infrastructure patching and security remediation.
* Automate Linux and Windows patch deployment, patch validation, compliance checks, and operational reporting.
* Develop automation scripts using Python, Bash, PowerShell, and Ansible.
* Implement Ansible playbooks for Linux patching, server configuration, security hardening, and vulnerability remediation.
* Automate patch readiness checks, server reboot coordination, service validation, and post-patching health checks.
* Integrate patching workflows with enterprise automation, orchestration, and IT service management platforms.
* Develop reusable scripts and automation frameworks to reduce manual intervention and improve patching consistency.
* Troubleshoot automation failures and continuously optimize patch deployment workflows.
* Identify opportunities to improve patch success rates, reduce patching cycle times, and increase infrastructure compliance through automation.

**Patch Compliance, Governance & Reporting**

* Track and maintain infrastructure patch compliance across Linux, Windows, and VMware platforms.
* Monitor patch deployment status, remediation progress, patch failures, and outstanding security vulnerabilities.
* Generate patch compliance dashboards, vulnerability remediation reports, and operational metrics.
* Ensure infrastructure patching activities align with enterprise security policies, regulatory requirements, and internal audit standards.
* Support security audits by providing patching evidence, remediation documentation, and compliance reports.
* Identify systems that are non-compliant, unsupported, or approaching end of life and develop remediation plans.
* Manage patching exceptions, risk assessments, and remediation timelines in coordination with cybersecurity and risk teams.
* Drive improvements in patch coverage, patch success rates, vulnerability remediation SLAs, and overall security posture.

**Infrastructure Support & Incident Management**

* Provide advanced L2/L3 technical support for Linux, Windows, VMware, and infrastructure patching platforms.
* Troubleshoot complex operating system, patching, application compatibility, performance, and availability issues.
* Participate in major incident management, root cause analysis (RCA), and problem management activities.
* Investigate infrastructure incidents caused by failed patches, operating system updates, configuration changes, or security remediation.
* Coordinate with application, database, network, storage, security, and infrastructure engineering teams to resolve cross-platform issues.
* Perform proactive infrastructure health checks, monitoring, and performance optimization.
* Support production change implementation, maintenance activities, and emergency security patch deployments.
* Develop and maintain operational runbooks, patching procedures, troubleshooting guides, and technical documentation.
* Participate in on-call support and scheduled maintenance activities to ensure critical infrastructure availability.

**Qualifications**
**Required Experience & Technical Skills**

* 7 years of overall IT infrastructure, system administration, patch management, or infrastructure security engineering experience.
* Strong hands-on experience managing enterprise-wide operating system patching and vulnerability remediation across large-scale infrastructure environments.
* Extensive expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL 7/8/9 or later), including administration, patching, kernel upgrades, troubleshooting, and security hardening.
* Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server 2016/2019/2022 or later, including administration, security updates, patch deployment, and troubleshooting.
* Strong experience with VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, virtualization management, patching, and lifecycle operations.
* Hands-on experience with Linux patch management tools such as Red Hat Satellite, YUM, DNF, and RPM.
* Experience with Windows patch management platforms such as SCCM/MECM, WSUS, or equivalent enterprise tools.
* Strong understanding of vulnerability management processes and remediation using tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management using Ansible.
* Hands-on scripting experience using Python, Bash/Shell scripting, and PowerShell.
* Strong understanding of operating system security hardening, CIS benchmarks, vulnerability remediation, and patch compliance.
* Experience managing critical and high-severity security vulnerabilities and meeting defined remediation SLAs.
* Good understanding of enterprise networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewalls, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of enterprise storage technologies, filesystems, and infrastructure performance management.
* Experience with patching governance, change management, incident management, and ITIL processes.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across operating systems, infrastructure security, patching platforms, VMware, networking, and storage.
* Experience supporting large-scale production infrastructure in highly regulated environments.
* Strong communication, documentation, analytical, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE).
* Microsoft Windows Server or infrastructure certification.
* Red Hat Ansible Automation certification.
* Experience with Red Hat Satellite, Ansible Automation Platform, Microsoft Configuration Manager, and enterprise patch orchestration solutions.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow, CMDB, change management, and automated patch compliance reporting.
* Knowledge of CIS benchmarks, NIST security frameworks, and enterprise security compliance requirements.
* Experience implementing automated vulnerability remediation and infrastructure security controls.

title: Cloud Administrator
description:
This role is technical in nature and focuses on building and maintaining Microsoft SQL Server and Postgres databases. You will be responsible for the delivery of database support services to FNZ platforms hosted in public cloud environments (Azure and AWS), through Infrastructure as Code pipelines and manual builds.

The Cloud Infrastructure team is small, and each team member is given the opportunity to own significant parts of the solution end to end. The Cloud DBA is expected to work with the Cloud Engineers to develop the best possible database solution for our internal stakeholders to do our part in delivering customer success.

**Team Responsibilities: -**

1. Automate the design, build, and maintenance of database environments to ensure high availability and scalability.
2. Use monitoring tools to optimize performance and proactively resolve issues.
3. Implement automated backup and disaster recovery pipelines to protect critical data.
4. Enforce security through automated user and access management.
5. Diagnose and resolve performance issues using modern diagnostic tools.
6. Leverage cloud-native automation to scale storage and manage capacity efficiently.

**Specific Role Responsibilities:-**

* Maintain and monitor Azure and AWS database services to ensure high availability and performance.
* Troubleshoot issues, optimize queries, and meet performance SLAs.
* Implement and manage backups, failover solutions, and disaster recovery plans.
* Enforce security protocols and manage access controls.
* Collaborate with the cloud engineering team to design, build, and run pipelines that automate database build and maintenance tasks.
* Support database builds and project delivery while working closely with developers to optimize performance.
* Participate in a global on-call support roster to address critical issues and maintain service reliability.
* Stay updated on Azure and AWS technologies and share knowledge with the team.
* Manage incident, problem and change management via FNZs ticketing solution.
* Participate in risk management and information security initiatives, supporting internal and external audits.
* Manage escalations to the appropriate stakeholders.

**Performance Assessment**

* Uptime and performance metrics in Azure and AWS
* Quality of security documentation and adherence to cloud security standards.
* Backup and recovery test results, and DR plan performance in cloud environments.
* Project timelines, quality metrics, and cost efficiency.

**Experience Required**

* Required2+ years of experience as a Database Administrator in Azure and/or AWS environments.
* Experience with Microsoft SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL, including database design and optimization.
* Demonstrated ability or strong interest in working within dynamic, high-availability environments. Exposure to or eagerness to learn about mission-critical systems is highly valued.
* Proven ability to work as an individual, with excellent self-management and time management skills.
* Ability to participate in an on-call roster and perform some work outside normal business hours.
* Superior problem-solving capabilities and the ability to multitask and re-prioritise work in a rapidly changing environment.

**Desirable**

* Experience with other cloud data storage services such as Microsoft Fabric or Power BI .
* Familiarity with cloud cost optimization and capacity planning.

**About the Role**

You'll take unclear problems and turn them into reliable, production-grade systems. You won't get a detailed spec. You'll get a problem, context, and the freedom to decide how to solve it. You'll own the full lifecycle: understanding the problem, designing, building, shipping, monitoring and iterating.

We're AI-native. You'll use coding agents and agentic workflows daily to move faster, and you stay fully accountable for everything you ship.

We don't hire based on familiarity with a particular programming language, framework, or technology stack.
**We value strong fundamentals, problem-solving ability, learning speed, engineering judgment, and the ability to deliver working software.**

**What You'll Do**

* Own features and services end to end, from discovery and design through deployment and monitoring
* Work across backend, data, infrastructure, integrations and AI-powered workflows, depending on what the problem needs
* Make and defend architectural trade-offs (performance, cost, complexity, speed)
* Debug production failures, find root causes, and improve observability and resilience
* Build internal tools and automations that remove repetitive engineering work
* Prototype quickly, validate assumptions, and turn what works into production code
* Use AI agents, tool calling and MCP integrations to compress delivery cycles, and review their output critically
* Raise the bar on code quality and engineering practices through your own work and reviews

**Must have**

* 2-4 years building and running production software
* Strong fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, databases, OS/networking basics, concurrency, system design
* Experience across more than one domain, such as backend/APIs, data-heavy systems, queues and async processing, cloud and deployment, third-party integrations, or AI/LLM applications
* Comfort entering an unfamiliar codebase and learning a new language or tool when the problem demands it
* Hands-on use of AI coding tools, and the judgment to catch hallucinations and hidden failure modes in generated code
* A track record of finishing things: shipping, then fixing, then measuring impact

**Strong plus**

* Experience at a product company or on a high-scale system
* Performance, reliability or data-consistency work with measurable results
* Internal tools, automation, or agent-based workflows you've built
* Frontend or mobile exposure
* B.Tech/B.E. in CS, IT, ECE, EE or a related field, ideally from a strong engineering program

**How You'll Be Evaluated**

1. **Resume and work review:**
   a conversation about what you personally built and the measurable impact
2. **Practical coding round:**
   write, debug and test code under realistic constraints
3. **System design:**
   an open-ended design problem sized to a real scale
4. **AI-assisted build:**
   solve a task with an AI agent while we watch how you steer, verify and test
5. **Hiring manager conversation:**
   your hardest problems, failures, and what you learned

**Why Join**

* Real ownership and direct business impact from week one
* Exposure across stacks and domains
* Hands-on experience building with AI agents on production systems

**Apply Now!**

title: Product Engineer
description:
**About Chariot**

Chariot is a frontier AI research lab based in Delhi, building foundation models. We're one of the original four teams selected under the IndiaAI Mission to build models from India. We want our models to work as well in Indian languages as the best AI systems work in English.

**The Role**

You'll build and own products powered by Chariot's models, from understanding a user's problem and deciding what to build to shipping it, measuring how it performs, and improving it.

This is a hands-on engineering role across the frontend and backend. You'll work directly with users and researchers, make product and engineering decisions, and take responsibility for both the user experience and the systems behind it. Your ownership continues after launch: understanding whether people are getting value, finding where the product falls short, and deciding what to improve next.

What you'll work on

1. **Understand users and shape the product.**
   Work directly with users to understand their needs, identify problems worth solving, and decide what to build. Scope work into useful increments and make clear choices about what belongs in the first version and what can wait.
2. **Build and ship across the stack.**
   Turn ideas into working products, from interfaces and user flows to APIs and backend services. Own features through implementation, testing, deployment, and iteration.
3. **Measure and improve.**
   Decide what success looks like and instrument products to understand how people use them. Use usage data, feedback, and failure patterns to improve the experience and guide what you build next.
4. **Own the systems behind your products.**
   Build and operate backend services that perform reliably under real load, including APIs, queues, storage, and integrations with model inference. Improve latency, throughput, reliability, and cost as usage grows.
5. **Connect product feedback to model quality.**
   Work with researchers to understand where models succeed or fail in real use. Build evaluation tools and automated checks that measure the quality of model-powered features, catch regressions, and help guide improvements.

What we look for

* **Strong product sense.**
  You can work through an ambiguous user problem, choose what matters, and explain why. You know how to scope a first version, decide what to measure, and use evidence to improve it.
* **Extensive experience building and operating backend systems at scale.**
  You've owned production services under real load, handled failures, and made informed tradeoffs around architecture, performance, reliability, and cost.
* **Full-stack engineering ability.**
  You're comfortable building usable interfaces and the services behind them, and carrying a feature through to production. You pay attention to the details that make a product clear and easy to use.
* **Strong software fundamentals, especially in Python.**
  You write maintainable code, understand distributed systems and data infrastructure, and can investigate problems across the stack.
* **Thoughtful use of AI tools.**
  AI tools are part of how you build. You know how to give them useful context, review their output, and verify correctness. You remain accountable for the code, architecture, and user experience you ship.
* **Ownership beyond launch.**
  You follow through on adoption, quality, and reliability. You're comfortable revisiting decisions and changing course when something isn't working.

Experience with model serving, GPU infrastructure, large-scale data pipelines, ML evaluation, speech systems, or multilingual products is a strong plus.

How to apply

Send us your resume, links to code or products you've built, and a short note on why this role interests you.

* Tell us about a product or feature you owned end to end: how you chose what to build, the scale and engineering challenges involved, and what you learned from users after launch.

* Cloud Migration & Modernization: Lead and contribute to migration of workloads from on-premise / PCF estates to AWS-native and containerized (Kubernetes/Docker) platforms, ensuring resilience and zero-business-impact cutovers.

title: Electrical Engineering & Computer Science
description:
**About Turing:**

* Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking an experienced Electrical Engineering or Computer Science expert to lead a team of technical trainers developing realistic, terminal-based scientific and engineering tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative.
* In this role, you will oversee a pod of approximately 5–10 trainers, review technical tasks for accuracy, reproducibility, and evaluation quality, and ensure tasks reflect authentic computer science, software systems, and electrical engineering workflows. You will also mentor trainers, maintain quality standards, and drive consistent delivery of challenging technical tasks.

**What you'll do:**

* Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of scientific and engineering tasks.
* Review technical tasks end to end, including problem statements, codebases, circuit netlists, hardware description languages (HDL), datasets, computational environments, reference solutions, and automated tests.
* Validate tasks involving high-performance computing (HPC), parallel computing, algorithms, distributed systems, compilers, operating systems, databases, ML systems, GPU computing, circuit design, signal processing, power systems, and embedded systems.
* Ensure tasks reflect realistic software engineering, research, and electrical engineering workflows requiring meaningful multi-step technical reasoning.
* Verify technical correctness across algorithm complexity, numerical accuracy, memory management, concurrency, circuit laws, power balance, signal processing, timing constraints, and system stability.
* Validate compilers, simulation tools, software dependencies, computational environments, and build processes to ensure reproducible results.
* Identify unreliable tests caused by nondeterministic behavior, race conditions, hardware-dependent performance thresholds, or simulation convergence issues.
* Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful technical outputs such as functional correctness, performance, frequency response, waveforms, timing, efficiency, and system behavior.
* Identify technical inaccuracies, flawed assumptions, incorrect tolerances, and opportunities to bypass computation, simulations, or automated evaluations.
* Provide clear, actionable technical feedback, track revisions, and ensure quality issues are resolved before task approval.
* Onboard trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, escalate blockers, and maintain technical documentation and best practices.

**What we're looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Strong programming skills in C/C++, Rust, Python, Julia, Fortran, MATLAB/Octave, or hardware description languages (HDL), with advanced Linux and terminal proficiency.
* Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: parallel computing, systems programming, scientific software development, circuit simulation, signal processing, power systems, or digital hardware design.
* Strong understanding of algorithms, computational systems, numerical methods, software testing, or electrical engineering principles.
* Experience reviewing complex codebases, technical implementations, engineering simulations, or research outputs.
* Ability to evaluate algorithm correctness, computational performance, numerical accuracy, concurrency behavior, and reliability of technical results.
* Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical errors, edge cases, race conditions, and flawed engineering assumptions.
* Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams.
* Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with HPC and systems development tools such as MPI, OpenMP, CUDA, LLVM/GCC, CMake, gdb, Valgrind, perf, sanitizers, or Slurm.
* Familiarity with electrical engineering and hardware simulation tools such as ngspice, Xyce, Icarus Verilog, Verilator, GHDL, Yosys, pandapower, PyPSA, MATPOWER, openEMS, GNU Radio, or QEMU.
* Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks such as pytest.
* Experience developing technical benchmarks, programming challenges, simulation-based evaluations, or automated grading systems.
* Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated technical solutions.
* Open-source development or maintainer experience, particularly reviewing and validating external contributions.
* Industry experience in semiconductors, high-performance computing, power utilities, telecommunications, or embedded systems.
* Prior experience in AI training, technical quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

**Offer Details:**

* **Commitments Required:**
  At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
* **Employment type :**
  Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
* **Duration of contract :**

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Role Overview

* Role: Solution & Integration Architect
* Team: Technology
* Reporting to: Global CTO
* Location: Mumbai or Delhi, India
* Employment Type: Full-time
* Experience: Typically 8–12+ years, including at least 3 years in solution architecture or a technical leadership role.

Role Purpose

The Solution & Integration Architect is responsible for designing scalable enterprise solutions and seamless integrations between a digital property decisioning platform and banks’ existing technology systems.

The role acts as a technical bridge between customers, Product, Engineering, IT Operations and leadership, ensuring that business requirements are translated into practical, secure, and buildable technical solutions. It involves hands-on API design, troubleshooting, customer engagement, and end-to-end integration delivery.

Key Responsibilities

1. Solution Architecture

* Lead technical discovery and architecture workshops with banking customers.
* Design solution architectures, application components, data flows, security, and non-functional requirements.
* Maintain architecture documentation, decision records, risks, and dependencies.
* Promote reusable solutions and minimise customer-specific development.

2. API and Integration Design

* Design and document REST APIs, webhooks, callbacks, event-driven integrations, and secure file transfers.
* Develop API specifications using OpenAPI/Swagger, including payloads, validation, error handling, versioning, retries, and idempotency.
* Define authentication, authorisation, certificates, and secure connectivity.
* Work with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure API Management, Service Bus, Functions, and App Services.
* Troubleshoot integration issues using logs, API traces, and monitoring tools.

3. Requirements Definition

* Work with Product Managers, Product Owners, Business Analysts, and customers to gather requirements.
* Translate business needs into technical specifications, API contracts, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Identify gaps, edge cases, dependencies, and technical constraints.
* Support backlog refinement, estimation, prioritisation discussions, and solution feasibility assessments.

4. Customer Integration Delivery

* Act as the primary technical contact for bank integration teams and third-party vendors.
* Coordinate connectivity, certificates, whitelisting, environments, and security approvals.
* Support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect resolution, go-live, and post-launch support.
* Ensure integrations are properly documented and handed over to Support and IT Operations.

5. Security and Compliance

* Ensure designs meet banking security requirements and enterprise security standards.
* Address data protection, encryption, data residency, audit logging, and retention requirements.
* Support security assessments and compliance reviews involving RBI guidance, the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, and CERT-In requirements.

6. Architecture Standards and Continuous Improvement

* Develop reusable architecture patterns, integration templates, and API standards.
* Improve onboarding efficiency across multiple banking customers.
* Capture implementation lessons and collaborate with global architecture, Product, and Engineering teams.

Essential Skills and Experience

* Enterprise solution architecture and integration design, preferably in banking or financial services.
* Strong hands-on experience with REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, JSON, and XML.
* OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, mutual TLS, certificates, and API security.
* Microsoft Azure integration services and API management.
* Event-driven messaging, webhooks, callbacks, batch processing, and SFTP.
* API versioning, retries, timeouts, error handling, and idempotency.
* Experience integrating with loan origination systems, loan management systems, core banking platforms, document management systems, and bank middleware.
* Understanding of banking network security, release governance, SIT, and UAT.
* Experience writing technical specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, problem-solving, and technical troubleshooting skills.

Good-to-Have Skills

* .NET or Java development experience.
* Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Experience working with Indian public sector banks.
* Knowledge of Finacle, TCS BaNCS, Oracle FLEXCUBE, or similar core banking platforms.
* Familiarity with RBI regulations, data protection, ISO 27001, and SOC 2.
* TOGAF or other architecture frameworks.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, and integration monitoring tools.

Key Success Metrics

Performance will be measured by:

* Quality and completeness of solution designs and API specifications.
* Clear, testable requirements with minimal engineering rework.
* Successful integration delivery through SIT, UAT, and production go-live.
* Reduction in integration defects and troubleshooting time.
* Reuse of common APIs, templates, and integration patterns.
* Positive feedback from banking technology and security teams.
* Accurate documentation and effective handover to operational teams.
* Reliable technical commitments aligned with platform capabilities.

title: Vulnerability Management Analyst
description:

title: Chemical Engineering
description:
**About Turing:**

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking an experienced Chemical Engineering expert to lead a team of technical trainers developing realistic, terminal-based engineering tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative.
* In this role, you will oversee a pod of approximately 5–10 trainers, review chemical engineering tasks for technical accuracy, reproducibility, and evaluation quality, and ensure tasks reflect authentic chemical engineering workflows. You will also mentor trainers, maintain quality standards, and drive consistent task delivery.

**What you'll do:**

* Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of chemical engineering tasks.
* Review engineering tasks end to end, including problem statements, reaction kinetics, thermodynamic and property data, process flowsheets, computational environments, reference solutions, and automated tests.
* Validate tasks involving reaction engineering, thermodynamics, phase equilibria, transport phenomena, separation processes, process simulation, process control, optimization, combustion, and electrochemical engineering.
* Ensure tasks reflect realistic chemical engineering workflows and require meaningful multi-step technical reasoning.
* Verify engineering correctness across mass and energy balances, thermodynamic consistency, property data, unit handling, and numerical convergence.
* Validate computational models, stiff ODE/DAE solvers, solver tolerances, initial conditions, and simulation results to ensure reproducibility and technical accuracy.
* Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful engineering outputs such as conversion, yield, selectivity, purity, energy consumption, and process constraint satisfaction.
* Identify technical inaccuracies, unrealistic assumptions, incorrect tolerances, and opportunities to bypass engineering calculations or simulations.
* Provide clear, actionable technical feedback, track revisions, and ensure quality issues are resolved before task approval.
* Onboard trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, escalate blockers, and maintain technical documentation and best practices.

**What we're looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Chemical Engineering.
* Strong programming skills in Python, Julia, C/C++, or MATLAB/Octave, with proficiency in Linux environments.
* Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: process modeling, reaction kinetics, thermodynamic modeling, process simulation, or optimization.
* Strong understanding of chemical engineering fundamentals, numerical methods, computational modeling, and technical validation.
* Experience reviewing complex technical work, chemical process simulations, computational models, or research outputs.
* Ability to evaluate mass and energy balances, thermodynamic assumptions, numerical accuracy, solver convergence, and the reliability of computational results.
* Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical errors, edge cases, and flawed engineering assumptions.
* Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams.
* Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with chemical engineering simulation and computational tools such as Cantera, CoolProp, Pyomo, IDAES, DWSIM, CasADi, or OpenFOAM.
* Familiarity with commercial process simulation software such as Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS, or gPROMS, including reproducing workflows using open-source tools.
* Experience with process optimization, reactor modeling, separation systems, process control, or electrochemical simulations.
* Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated engineering solutions.
* Industry experience in petrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, energy, specialty chemicals, or chemical process manufacturing.
* Prior experience in AI training, technical quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

  4 week [expected start date is next week]

title: AI Specialist Revenue Operations (India Remote)
description:
**Company Description**
  
When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.
  
  
Experience a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
  
  
Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
  
  
  
**Job Description**
  
The AI Specialist, Revenue Operations is responsible for building and running the AI workloads that support the global revenue organization. Revenue Operations is establishing an AI orchestration platform alongside a set of AI agents and automations that change how commercial teams work, and this role is the first dedicated build resource within it.
  
  
The primary focus is twofold. The role develops automations and agent features against a defined specification, and it owns the operational work that keeps live AI systems healthy and measurably effective: evaluation, knowledge curation, monitoring and first-line diagnosis. Technical direction and platform architecture are set by the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
  
  
This role also assists in establishing the working practices that Revenue Operations will follow. The standards this role helps set around documentation, evaluation and production readiness will determine how quickly our AI platforms can scale, and how much of the technical work can be safely devolved over time.
  
  
**Core areas of impact include:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Building AI agents, automations and integrations against a defined specification.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Establishing and running the evaluation that evidences AI agent performance.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Maintaining the knowledge bases and data that grounded AI agents depend on.
* **Operational Support:**
  Monitoring live AI workloads and owning first-line diagnosis of failures.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supporting the movement of AI workloads through technical and security review into production.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Builds automations and AI agent features against a written specification and within the platform's established patterns, including prompt development, retrieval and knowledge grounding.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Authors and runs evaluation test cases for AI workloads, extends coverage as those workloads change, and produces the reporting that evidences whether agent performance is improving.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Curates and maintains the knowledge bases, content and data that grounded AI agents depend on, and prepares and transforms data for agent consumption.
* **Workload Operations:**
  Monitors live AI workloads, owns first-line investigation of failures, resolves issues within scope, and escalates the remainder with a clear technical diagnosis.
* **Integration Development:**
  Builds and maintains integrations with Revenue Operations systems through APIs and workflow orchestration tooling, with due attention to authentication, error handling and access control.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supports the movement of AI workloads into production by assembling technical documentation, completing security and access reviews, and preparing release and rollback notes.
* **Technical Documentation:**
  Maintains accurate documentation for all AI workloads, and documents reusable patterns so that each successive build is faster to deliver than the last.
* **Platform Contribution:**
  Contributes to the ongoing development of an AI orchestration platform under the technical direction of the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
* **Stakeholder Communication:**
  Explains the behavior and limitations of AI workloads clearly to non-technical colleagues across Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and the wider revenue organization.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Gathers feedback from users of live AI workloads and applies it to improve agent quality and reliability.

  
  
**Qualifications**
  
**Proven Characteristics for Success**

* Demonstrated ability to build working software with AI tooling, evidenced by delivered work rather than formal training alone.
* Strong diagnostic instinct and the persistence to establish why a system behaved as it did.
* Comfortable working to a defined technical direction while taking full ownership of implementation.
* Surfaces ambiguity in a specification rather than proceeding on assumption.
* Data-driven approach to quality, focused on measurement rather than assertion.
* Disciplined about documentation, with an understanding of why it matters to a small technical team.
* Highly organized with an action-oriented mindset and strong written communication skills.

**Qualifications, Skills, and Knowledge / Experience**
**Essential**

* Hands-on experience building with large language model APIs, including prompt engineering and retrieval or knowledge base systems. Self-directed and personal project work is considered.
* Working knowledge of Python or JavaScript, sufficient to read, modify and extend an existing codebase confidently.
* Practical experience integrating with REST APIs, including authentication and handling failure conditions in systems outside the developer's control.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational data structures.
* Excellent written communication, particularly in documenting technical findings for a mixed audience.
* Legal eligibility for authorized employment within the India region.
* Fluent in verbal and written English.

**Preferred**

* Experience with a workflow automation or orchestration platform such as n8n, Make or Zapier.
* Technical exposure to a CRM or sales engagement platform, such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Experience in software testing, quality assurance or the evaluation of AI systems.
* Experience in technical support, troubleshooting or incident diagnosis.
* Experience with knowledge management, content curation or technical documentation.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS.
* Experience with conversational or voice AI platforms.
* Knowledge and experience working within the EdTech sector.

**Education**

* Educated to degree level in a technical discipline or equivalent demonstrable experience. Candidates with a portfolio of self-taught, built work are encouraged to apply.

**Tii Elements**

* **Curiosity:**
  Has a growth mindset and leads with questions vs. assumptions. Unleashes creativity and possibility by actively seeking new experiences, information, and knowledge; embraces challenge, takes risks, learns fast and welcomes change.
* **Resourcefulness:**
  Possesses a mindset of abundance and redefines what's possible; creates and advances ways of achieving results in new or difficult situations either by appropriating additional resources, or by doing more with less.
* **Quality Focus:**
  Setting high quality standards for our work and striving for continuous improvement and quality assurance so that our internal & external customers get the best possible outcomes.
* **Self-Awareness & Impact:**
  Shows awareness of the impacts of one's choices, words, decisions and actions on others and on the business. And aligns behaviors with intended outcomes.

  
  
**Additional Information**
  
**Total Rewards @ Turnitin**
  
At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.
  
  
Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.
  
  
In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being.
  
  
**Our Mission**
is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.
  
  
  
  
**Our Values**
underpin everything we do.
  

* **Customer Centric:**

* **Passion for Learning:**
  We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
* **Integrity:**

* **Action & Ownership:**
  We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
* **One Team:**
  We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
* **Global Mindset:**

**Global Benefits**

\* varies by country
  
  
**Seeing Beyond the Job Ad**
  
At Turnitin, we recognize it’s unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria in a job ad.  We encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of the requirements because we know that skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

P R O D U C T S E C U R I T Y · A N A P L A N

**Reports to:**

**Working model:**
Gurugram (Hybrid)

Why this role matters

This is an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact at Anaplan! In this role, you will be at the forefront of scaling security through automation and self-service. You’ll be the driving force behind transforming security intent into enforced, self-service controls across the SDLC and CI/CD pipelines. Think dependency policy, secrets handling, least-privilege access, and the guardrails that allow engineering teams to innovate rapidly without compromising security.

When done right, this is some of the most high-leverage work in our function. Every control you implement will run continuously for every team, seamlessly integrated into their workflows!

Why Anaplan

Anaplan is not just another SaaS application; it’s a powerful platform that performs highly dimensional, enterprise-scale modeling with responsive recalculation and strong correctness expectations. Our technical landscape is rich and varied, featuring the legacy Hyperblock engine, the innovative Polaris engine, and an expanding suite of AI-powered products like CoModeler for AI-assisted model building and CoPlanner for conversational, analyst-style planning support.

With AI revolutionizing software development, we are embracing more generated code and autonomous changes, making the need for encoded, verifiable guardrails more critical than ever. Security is woven into the fabric of how our platform evolves, rather than treated as an afterthought. Join our small, dynamic team where your contributions to automation will set the gold standard!

What you'll do

* Automate across the pipeline: build security automation into CI/CD and the broader SDLC so that controls run as code.
* Leverage AI to scale security automation: harness AI and LLM-assisted tools to speed up control development, triage, and remediation, extending automated coverage beyond what traditional scripts can achieve.
* Implement policy-as-code: encode guardrails for dependency and package policies, secrets, and configurations so they enforce themselves effortlessly.
* Build the controlled-repository model: automate the restriction of external dependencies and provide safe, approved package paths for our engineers.
* Automate secrets management and detection: ensure mishandled or leaked secrets are automatically caught and managed without the need for manual sweeps.
* Reduce standing privilege: develop automation for least privilege and just-in-time access, making persistent access the exception rather than the rule.
* Tame scanner output: integrate detection into low-noise, actionable workflows that feed remediation, preventing overwhelming flood of alerts.
* Automate attack-surface hardening: drive the creation of hardened, golden images and enforce baselines through code.
* Make controls self-service: default to providing engineers with a paved path wherever it’s safe to do so, rather than imposing unnecessary gates.

What we're looking for

* Strong automation and engineering skills, particularly in languages such as Python or Go, along with expertise in infrastructure-as-code and pipeline work.
* In-depth knowledge of DevSecOps: CI/CD security and hands-on experience with policy-as-code using tools like OPA, Conftest, or Kyverno.
* Foundational understanding of cloud-native security, particularly in Kubernetes and at least one major cloud provider, along with knowledge of secrets management and identity basics.
* A builder's instinct: you create tools that engineers love because they simplify their work.
* Genuine care for developer experience, always striving to reduce friction rather than adding unnecessary barriers.
* The discernment to identify which controls are truly worth encoding and which can be set aside.

Nice to have

* Experience with supply-chain security: understanding of provenance and signing, as well as software or model bills of materials.
* Familiarity with zero-trust and least-privilege automation, including just-in-time access.
* Experience working in a regulated, enterprise environment.
* Contributions to open-source security tooling or relevant certifications.

title: Software Development Engineer -1
description:
**About Mechademy**

Mechademy is transforming the predictive analytics landscape for rotating machinery. Our flagship platform, Turbomechanica, seamlessly integrates applied physics with advanced machine learning to deliver prescriptive insights. Turbomechanica detects potential issues long before they become costly failures, enabling clients to maximize uptime, extend asset life, and reduce operational risks. By empowering clients with optimized performance and reliability of their multi-billion-dollar assets, we’re setting a new standard for operational excellence.

**What We’re Looking For**

People who would rather build than talk about building. You’ll fit right in if you:

* Like owning a problem end to end, from the first design note to production.
* Pick up new tools quickly, and have opinions about which ones we should use.
* Care about getting things right, because engineers make real decisions on what we build.
* Enjoy a small, energetic team that ships fast and celebrates its wins.

**Why Mechademy?**

Kickstart your career with a company that’s fun, innovative, and shaping the future of the oil and gas industry. Mechademy is where cutting-edge predictive analytics meets a culture of collaboration and creativity. We’re not your typical start-up company – we thrive on solving complex challenges with technology, fostering growth, and making an impact. Whether you're diving into groundbreaking projects, learning from industry leaders, or enjoying team outings, you’ll feel valued and inspired every step of the way.

•
**Work on groundbreaking technology**
that is shaping the future of rotating equipment diagnostics.

•
**Relish a challenging, dynamic role**
with opportunities for individual contributions that direct impact on the success of the company.

•
**Grow into a leadership position**
as Mechademy grows.

•
**Enjoy flexible work hours**
to work when you are most efficient.

•
**Generous compensation**
to help you achieve financial stability.

At Mechademy, your ideas matter, your growth is our priority, and your future starts now.

**About the Role**

An unplanned trip of a single critical machine can halt production at an entire facility. Turbomechanica exists to see that coming, and the team makes sure the right people see it, trust it and act on it in time. You do not need an industrial or mechanical background. Our domain engineers will teach you how turbines and compressors fail.

**Responsibilities**

* **Platform -**
  Design, build and own features on a secure, multi-tenant platform used by enterprise clients across the globe. Work on authentication, access control and auditability, web and mobile experiences, and APIs that let other systems work with platform data safely.
* **Monitoring -**
  Build the workflows that turn detected issues into alerts, escalations and tracked actions, and the tooling that helps engineers prioritise, investigate and resolve issues faster. Work with large volumes of time series sensor data.
* **Reliability -**
  Add alerting, health checks and dashboards so we catch problems before a client does.
* **Engineering Quality -**
  Write clean, tested code and own features from design through production. Write design notes, take part in design and code reviews, and document what you build.
* **Ways of Working -**
  Ship in two-week sprints using Git, GitHub, CI/CD and ClickUp. Use modern developer tooling, including AI coding assistants, while staying accountable for every line you merge.

**Requirements**

**Must Have**

* B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, IT, Electronics or a related branch
* 1.5+ years building and shipping production software
* Strong Python (preferred), or Java, Go, TypeScript or similar; solid DSA and OOP fundamentals
* REST APIs with Django, FastAPI, Flask, Express or similar
* SQL and relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL
* JavaScript or TypeScript, React preferred
* Web authentication basics (sessions, tokens, OAuth) and secure coding
* Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD
* Clear communication and a real willingness to learn and take feedback
* LLM APIs (Claude and other leading models), Model Context Protocol (MCP), RAG and agent orchestration frameworks

**Good to Have**

* Open source work or side projects you can discuss in depth
* Interest or experience in applied machine learning or LLMs
* Multi-tenant SaaS systems
* Time series data or large datasets
* Mobile app development
* SSO / OIDC providers, role-based access control
* Docker, AWS or Azure in production; logging, monitoring and alerting tools
* Mentoring peers, writing clear design docs

**What This Role Offers**

* **Work that matters -**
  What you build runs in production every day at some of the world’s largest energy companies.
* **Hard, real problems -**
  Security, multi-tenancy, large-scale sensor data and systems engineers depend on.
* **Ownership -**
  A squad buddy gets you productive in 30 days; you own a part of the platform within 6 months.
* **Mentorship -**
  Learn from senior engineers and domain experts with decades of equipment experience.
* **Growth -**
  A clear path from SDE-1 to SDE-2.
* **Flexibility -**
  Flexible work hours and a hybrid setup.

**Selection Process**

1. Introductory call - A short conversation with our talent team about your background, interests and expectations.
2. Technical interview 1 - Problem solving and live coding, plus a deep dive into a project you have shipped.
3. Technical interview 2 - System design and full stack fundamentals: APIs, data modelling, scaling and trade-offs.
4. Hiring manager - A conversation with the P&M Squad Owner about how you work, own problems and grow.
5. HR and culture - Team fit, compensation and joining logistics.

*No trick puzzles. When you apply, tell us about something you have shipped. That matters more to us than where you have worked.*

title: DevOps Engineer – Cloud Infrastructure & SIP/VoIP
description:
DevOps Engineer – Cloud Infrastructure & SIP/VoIP (Voice AI)

InfoLabs Global | Sector 62, Noida | Full-time | On-site

We're hiring a DevOps Engineer to run the infrastructure behind real-time AI phone calls.

About InfoLabs Global

InfoLabs Global builds conversational and voice AI for enterprises and government organisations across India and the UAE. Our iCall platform runs AI voice agents that handle live phone calls in multiple languages, for banks, financial services, automotive, and public-sector clients.

We run our own telephony stack from end to end. Carrier SIP trunks come into our Asterisk middleware, which bridges calls into LiveKit, where our AI agents speak with callers in real time. We're looking for someone to own that entire path.

What you'll do

SIP & Telephony

- Integrate and manage SIP trunks with telecom carriers: IP whitelisting, authentication, codecs, DID/number routing

- Configure, run and harden Asterisk (PJSIP, dialplans, trunk failover, routing to LiveKit SIP)

- Troubleshoot call failures, one-way audio, NAT issues, jitter and packet loss

- Secure the VoIP edge with SIP firewalling, fail2ban, toll-fraud prevention, SRTP/TLS and rate limiting

- Coordinate directly with carrier engineering teams during setup and incidents

Cloud & Infrastructure

- Manage cloud infrastructure on AWS and Azure: VPCs, security groups, load balancers, DNS, IAM

- Deploy and operate self-hosted LiveKit across multiple regions, including TURN/coturn and TLS

- Run GPU servers for LLM, speech-to-text and text-to-speech workloads

- Containerise services and build CI/CD pipelines (Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions or similar)

- Manage infrastructure as code with Terraform or similar

- Keep cloud costs under control as call volumes scale

Reliability & Monitoring

- Set up monitoring, logging and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana or similar)

- Track call quality and capacity: concurrent calls, MOS, latency, error rates

- Be the go-to person when calls drop or audio breaks in production

What we're looking for

Must have

- 4+ years in DevOps, SRE or infrastructure roles

- Hands-on production experience with Asterisk

- Strong understanding of SIP and RTP: call flows, SDP, NAT traversal, codecs (G.711, Opus)

- Experience debugging with sngrep, tcpdump or Wireshark

- Experience integrating SIP trunks from telecom carriers

- Strong AWS skills (Azure is a plus)

- Solid Linux administration and networking (TCP/UDP, NAT, firewalls)

- Docker and CI/CD in production

Good to have

- FreeSWITCH or Kamailio

- LiveKit, WebRTC or LiveKit SIP

- Experience with Indian carriers (Airtel, Tata Tele, Jio, Vodafone Idea) and DoT/TRAI compliance

- Exposure to UAE carriers (du, Etisalat)

- GPU server management (CUDA, NVIDIA drivers, container toolkit)

- Kubernetes in production

- Python or Bash scripting for automation

Why join us

- Work on live voice AI used by banks, enterprises and government entities

- Own a stack where cloud, telephony and AI meet. Very few roles offer this mix

- Direct access to the founding and engineering leadership

- A fast-moving team where your decisions go to production quickly

How to apply

Apply through LinkedIn or send your CV to hr@infolabsglobal.ai with the subject "DevOps – SIP/VoIP".

In your application, tell us about one SIP or Asterisk issue you debugged in production and how you fixed it.

15 years full time education

title: Linux Systems & Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Miimansa focuses on addressing inefficiencies in the medical research-practice-delivery information flow, especially those caused by high costs and limitations of prospective clinical trials. The organization combines expertise in clinical data-management workflows, life sciences research, and artificial intelligence to improve how clinical research is conducted and translated into practice. By designing robust data and infrastructure “vasculature” for clinical research, Miimansa aims to enable more efficient, scalable, and reliable health insights. Team members work at the intersection of technology and healthcare, contributing to solutions that can impact real-world patient outcomes.

**About the role:**

We are looking for a hands-on Linux Systems & Infrastructure Engineer to support the computing and data-processing needs of our AI and research teams.The role spans Ubuntu/Linux administration, on-premise and cloud infrastructure, GPU-enabled workstations, computational environments, and infrastructure automation. The ideal candidate is comfortable with the command line, independent troubleshooting, scripting, and practical problem-solving in a fast-moving startup.You will work closely with technical and research teams to set up, maintain, monitor, and improve our computing infrastructure and supporting tools.

Key responsibilities

1. Linux systems and servers

* Set up, configure, and maintain Ubuntu/Linux systems across on-premise and cloud environments.
* Manage users, permissions, groups, storage, SSH access, and security controls.
* Monitor system health, CPU, memory, GPU, and storage utilization.
* Troubleshoot Linux, networking, hardware, and software issues, and maintain system documentation.

2. Data and compute environments

* Set up and maintain Python environments, packages, dependencies, and tools for data processing and AI workloads.
* Support researchers and engineers running large-scale data-processing and GPU workloads.
* Automate routine administration, monitoring, and data-processing tasks using Bash, Python, or similar tools.

3. GPU and workstation infrastructure

* Evaluate and recommend CPU, GPU, RAM, storage, networking, power, and cooling configurations for AI/ML and data-intensive workloads.
* Support hardware procurement, installation, configuration, testing, and benchmarking.
* Monitor compute resources and improve their utilization.

4. Resource monitoring and automation

* Develop scripts and lightweight tools to track system health, resource utilization, and user activity.
* Implement practical controls for shared computing resources and user access.
* Automate monitoring reports and alerts where appropriate.

5. General infrastructure responsibilities

* Take ownership of problems spanning hardware, software, networking, and infrastructure.
* Establish practical IT and computing practices as the organization grows.
* Work independently with evolving requirements, prioritizing simple, effective solutions.

Required skills

* Strong practical experience administering Ubuntu/Linux systems and servers.
* Comfortable with the Linux command line and independent troubleshooting.
* Experience with Bash scripting; Python scripting is preferred.
* Hands-on knowledge of Linux users, permissions, SSH, processes, services, storage, and networking.
* Familiarity with Git and software environments and dependency management.
* Understanding of CPU, RAM, GPU, storage, and networking hardware.
* Experience setting up or maintaining servers, workstations, or compute environments.
* Ability to develop scripts for routine administration, monitoring, and automation.

Desirable experience

* NVIDIA GPUs, CUDA, and AI/ML compute infrastructure.
* Docker and containerized workloads.
* Cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Slurm or other workload and resource management systems.
* Monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.
* Networking and firewall configuration.
* Ansible or other configuration-management tools.
* Supporting data science, machine learning, or research computing environments.

What we value

* A hands-on, resourceful approach and the ability to solve problems independently.
* Willingness to work across hardware, Linux, networking, scripting, and applications.
* A strong sense of ownership, without being constrained by narrow role boundaries.
* Careful attention to security, access control, and data handling.
* Comfort with ambiguity and changing priorities in a startup environment.
* A preference for simple, reliable solutions over unnecessary complexity.

Requirements added:

• 2+ years of work experience with Linux

• Bachelor's Degree
